nodes.label: Stale-cache boot-failure recovery (retry with backoff + sessionStorage loop-guard)
nodes.rationale: A boot failure here almost always means a stale cached shell after a deploy. Retries reload with increasing backoff (400ms + 1200ms*attempts), guards against infinite loops via a sessionStorage counter reset after a 90s window, and falls back to a manual 'close and reopen' message after 3 attempts.
